senses.gloss: m. (v. preced., cmp. גִּיסָא III) the wife’s sister’s husband, brother-in-law.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:4">Snh. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b">27ᵇ</cite>) <he>גִּיסוֹ</he> (Y. ib. III, 7 <he>אֲגִיסוֹ</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>גִּיסִין</he>. Y. Shek. I, end, 46ᵇ; a. e.
